A worker processes async jobs. Cancellation during queue.get leaves unfinished_tasks nonzero and join hangs. Write a corrected Python worker with task_done in the right place, bounded concurrency, explicit shutdown, and two focused tests.
Give the complete proposed implementation and explain the invariants.

A background importer retries a batch after its connection drops. Each record has a stable external id, but the importer increments a counter before committing. Give a transaction design and SQL pseudocode that makes replay idempotent and keeps the counter exact.
Give the complete proposed implementation and explain the invariants.

protocol.effect_gate: Absolute candidate/control time change exceeds max(2%, twice aggregate ABBA spread).
protocol.noise_gate: Each primary phase aggregate spread is at most 5%. Per-case wall and stream-decode endpoints have their own 5% spread gates.
protocol.output_gate: Every case has identical complete HTTP assistant text, completion count and finish reason across all 12 registered rounds within each phase. Preserve every failed identity gate and all raw timings.
protocol.cold_warm_output_gate: Every warm per-case endpoint requires text, completion count and finish reason to equal that request's cold output within each of the four rounds in its ABBA group. The warm aggregate requires this for every case. Recompute parity from raw HTTP results and validate the driver's text/count summary. Cold qualification remains independent of cold-to-warm parity.
protocol.cache_gate: All cold matched_tokens are 0 and all warm matched_tokens are >0, with the same per-case request body and cache salt in both phases.
protocol.operating_gate: Recorded controlled_round launch gate, AC throughout measurement, no serious/critical OS thermal state, no swap, valid unchanged artifacts and normal server shutdown.
protocol.direction_gate: A reported endpoint effect requires all three complete groups to qualify in the same direction. Every group is retained.
protocol.width_scope: Actual widths are recorded without requiring B4 or any particular batch shape to occur.
